# Olson Pro Wash (Olson Landscaping Pro Wash LLC)

> Locally owned pressure washing, roof cleaning and landscaping company based in
> Lake Stevens, Washington, serving Snohomish County and North King County.
> Founded by Ethan Olson. Licensed, bonded and insured. Phone: (425) 446-0547.
> Rated 4.9/5 on Google (54+ reviews). Hours: Mon–Thu 9am–12am, Fri–Sun 10am–12am. Email: olsonlandscapingcustomercare@gmail.com.

Key facts:
- Business name: Olson Pro Wash / Olson Landscaping Pro Wash LLC
- Owner/founder: Ethan Olson (Lake Stevens, WA)
- Base city: Lake Stevens, WA 98258
- Service area: Lake Stevens, Everett, Marysville, Arlington, Snohomish, Monroe,
  Mill Creek, Mukilteo, Bothell, Kirkland, Sammamish, Issaquah — Snohomish & King County
- Methods: soft washing (low pressure + detergent) for roofs and siding;
  pressure washing for concrete, brick and pavers (finished with a brightening post-treatment)
- Free, itemized, same-day quotes. Satisfaction guarantee.

## Services

Every service has its own page with a Pacific-Northwest rationale, a 4-step method, an FAQ, and links to that service in all 18 cities served.

- [Roof Cleaning](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/roof-cleaning): Low-pressure roof soft wash that removes moss, lichen and black streaks at the root, then a full rinse. Done to ARMA and shingle-manufacturer guidelines — premium soft wash (recommended) or a budget powder treatment. From $299.
- [House Washing](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/house-washing): Whole-home exterior soft wash of siding, soffits, fascia and trim (gutter-face brightening optional). From $199.
- [Pressure Washing](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/pressure-washing): High-pressure surface cleaning for concrete, brick, pavers and stone, finished with a post-treatment that kills organic growth and brightens the concrete toward brand-new. Hot water available for oil and grease. From $99.
- [Soft Washing](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/soft-washing): Low-pressure detergent cleaning for stucco, cedar, painted surfaces and fences. From $199.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/gutter-cleaning): Hand clear-out, every downspout flushed and flow-tested, ladder photos on completion. From $99.
- [Gutter Brightening](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/gutter-brightening): Low-pressure detergent soft wash of the exterior gutter faces — removes the black "tiger stripe" staining a rinse can't touch. Add-on to a gutter cleaning or house wash, or stand-alone. From $79.
- [Gutter Guard Installation](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/gutter-guard-installation): Raptor Type 304 stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards (~900 openings per sq in, aluminum V-bend frame, 25-year warranty), professionally installed over cleaned and re-pitched gutters. From $8/linear ft.
- [Deck & Patio Cleaning](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/deck-patio-cleaning): Wood, composite and stone, cleaned at the right pressure for the material. From $99.
- [Driveway & Concrete Cleaning](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/driveway-concrete-cleaning): Streak-free rotary surface cleaning with stain treatment. From $99.
- [Commercial Services](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/commercial-services): Recurring or one-time exterior maintenance for retail, restaurants, HOAs and property managers. Quoted per site.
- [Landscaping](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/landscaping): Bed design, mulch, edging, shrub trimming and seasonal clean-ups. From $179.
- [Christmas Light Installation](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/christmas-light-installation): Custom-cut commercial-grade holiday lights — every strand cut to the exact roofline. Install, in-season bulb service, January takedown and labeled storage. From $399 first season (re-hang seasons cost less).
- [Maintenance Plans](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/services/maintenance-plans): Scheduled, flat-rate exterior maintenance for homes, HOAs and commercial property — gutters, roof watch, house washing. Lower per-visit rates than one-off work, no lock-in.

- [Snohomish, WA](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/service-area/snohomish-wa): Historic downtown homes needing low-pressure soft washing; damp river-valley neighborhoods.
- [Monroe, WA](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/service-area/monroe-wa): Skykomish valley humidity; Fryelands subdivisions, rural acreage, recurring maintenance plans.
- [Mill Creek, WA](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/service-area/mill-creek-wa): Master-planned HOA neighborhoods; scheduled house-wash / roof / gutter programs with documentation.
- [Mukilteo, WA](https://olsonlandscapingprowash.com/service-area/mukilteo-wa): Bluff-top and waterfront salt exposure; Harbour Pointe community, frequent house washing.

## Common questions

- Roof cleaning follows ARMA and shingle-manufacturer guidelines. Recommended method is a low-pressure soft wash (biocide treatment, then a full rinse); a lower-cost budget powder treatment is also offered.
- Typical roof soft wash in the Lake Stevens area runs $299–$1,000 depending on slope area and moss coverage.
- Most Pacific Northwest homes should be washed once a year; roofs every 1–2 years.
- Detergents are biodegradable, applied at safe dilution, with landscaping pre-wet and rinsed.
- Olson Pro Wash is licensed, bonded and insured in Washington (Contractor Registration #OLSONLP747MF) and provides a certificate of insurance on request.
